author: LegalEagle
description:
Democrats want Trump to preserve every prompt he and his staff have sent to AI chatbots 🗂️ 

Robert Garcia and Jamie Raskin wrote directly to the president demanding he preserve every prompt submitted to chatbots including Grok, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity, along with every response those systems generated. The letter followed reports that Trump had consulted Elon Musk’s Grok about the military operation in Venezuela. 

Their legal argument rests on the Presidential Records Act. If prompts and responses were used for official government business, Democrats argue, they qualify as presidential records. As paralegal Katherine Toups pointed out, chatbot logs often reveal a user’s thinking, intent, and state of mind. 

These are genuinely unsettled questions. The Presidential Records Act was written long before anyone asked a chatbot for military advice, and National Archives guidance generally treats chatbot conversations as federal records when they’re captured and maintained
title: Do Trump’s AI Chatbot Prompts Count as Presidential Records?
